# Buy Sell Trade SXM

> Local online marketplace to buy, sell and trade second-hand items and services across Saint-Martin and Sint Maarten. Prices in euros or US dollars, site and app in English and French.

## Main pages
- [Marketplace app](https://buyselltradesxm.com/app.html): what the app does, English
- [Application (français)](https://buyselltradesxm.com/app-fr.html): présentation de l'application
- [All listings](https://buyselltradesxm.com/l/): current listings, one page per listing
- [Home](https://buyselltradesxm.com/): search and browse listings, post an ad

## Legal
- [Privacy policy](https://buyselltradesxm.com/privacy.html)
- [Terms of use](https://buyselltradesxm.com/terms.html)

## Notes
- Each listing page (https://buyselltradesxm.com/l/<id>.html) has the title, price, area and photos of one item.
- Sitemap: https://buyselltradesxm.com/sitemap.xml
